name: @brainmux/llmproxy
description: Run Claude Code on cheap/alternate LLM brains and delegate grunt work to save your Opus quota.

scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run bundle
scripts.dist-check: npm run bundle && git diff --exit-code -- dist/bmux.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run bundle && node --test "dist/test/**/*.test.js"
